name: Geisler Electric
old_description: At Geisler Electric, you can trust us to treat you like family and to do a great job by providing a quick response to your call. We will send a clean, courteous, and reliable service professional that fixes your problem RIGHT the first time, all at a guaranteed price. Geisler Electric is the most on-time and efficient electrical contractor in the area – guaranteed! We’re proud to be the top electrical contractors in Kansas City, KS and the surrounding areas.
about:
Geisler Electric was founded in 2013 in Manhattan, Kansas, by Joe Geisler as a family-owned electrical contracting business. The company began with a focus on residential and commercial electrical installations, troubleshooting, and upgrades, serving the Manhattan area and surrounding communities. In 2024, the firm expanded its service territory to include the Kansas City metropolitan area.

The company provides a range of electrical services including residential and commercial wiring, panel change-outs, security system installation, home networking, EV charging station installation, smart lighting control, and generator installation. Technicians operate from fully stocked service trucks, enabling on-site repairs without additional supply runs. Geisler Electric maintains regular business hours Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with 24/7 emergency service available year-round. The company holds Kansas electrical contractor licensing.

Geisler Electric serves homeowners, businesses, and industrial facilities. Its customer base includes residential clients in Manhattan and the Kansas City metro area, commercial offices, retail spaces, and industrial operations such as a processing facility that required immediate electrical repairs. The company also supports smart home and smart building projects, integrating audio/video, automated lighting, and environmental control systems.

The firm emphasizes a family-owned, neighborly approach, aiming to treat clients like family and ensure safety through top-notch service. Its differentiators include round-the-clock emergency response, fully equipped trucks, and a commitment to completing projects with precision and care. The company states its mission is to solve electrical issues and keep customers safe in their homes and workplaces.
